reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, so a sachet made to go does not solve anything for me. I travel only twice a month, and a bottle in my bag covers that.
objection: I don't need it to go. I have a routine at home and paying $29.99 for portability I rarely use is not worth it.
would_change_my_mind: If it were clearly cheaper than my current bottle per day, or if I started traveling much more and kept forgetting my pills.
